---
title: "Lever derivatives from the shared row series"
---

The corrected `lever_jacobian` includes the ionic packing-diameter volume chain.
At an accepted one-liquid electrolyte equilibrium at 300 K and 100 kPa, its
first chemical-row derivative is 0.07248519480266756 per angstrom, replacing
0.30591249238080681 from the dense assembly.
Centered diameter steps of 1e-4 and 1e-5 angstrom give
0.072485194850813173 and 0.07248519482416782 per angstrom.
The central classified residual is 1.7625900738948984e-14.
These values verify the derivative numerically; they establish no physical
validation or parameter adoption.

## Calculation and retained basis

The baseline is `bdde4003db7fda654655fdc42e684f60b4a29cfd`, merged before this
correction; it reproduces all 230 dense entries retained in the initial
`96e9ecde` investigation.
[`summary.json`](results/summary.json) identifies the baseline and corrected
non-editable wheels, numerical comparisons, source inspection and table hashes.

`lever_jacobian` now prepares one center and takes first row-series coefficients
along unit directions in T, P, feed-amount and active-parameter order.
A free T/P column drives the corresponding state coordinate, preserving the
callable's previous column definition; its external control entry is ignored
by `row_series`.
Primal-only points retain zero missing multipliers through padding of the
prepared coordinates, after the original point admission.
The reference refusal, callable, matrix shape and diagnostic meanings remain.
`PackingTerms::parameter_derivative` and its analytic producer have been removed.
[ALG-ACTIONS](../../engine/docs/science/algorithms.md#alg-actions) records this
shared first-coefficient calculation and the correction.

For an ion, the packing coefficient contains its diameter cubed.
At fixed packing fraction and composition, volume is the packing coefficient
divided by the packing fraction.
The old producer handled segment count, neutral constant sigma and neutral
dispersion energy, leaving `PackingDiameter` at zero.
The shared geometry differentiates this diameter and propagates its volume
response through both chemical and pressure rows, as required by the
[packing-coefficient derivative equation](../../engine/docs/equations.md#packing_coefficient_parameter_derivative).
Production sensitivities already used this chain; this corrects the dense
callable and its readers.

The matrices use the baseline native numerical input builders
`properties_support::neutral_ternary`, `aqueous_electrolyte` and
`equilibrium_support::flash`.
The two neutral cases evaluate defining rows at their generic positive chart
points, at 300 K and 100 kPa.
The free-T/P case has three phases, fractions 0.2 and 0.3 pinned, and feed
amounts (0.6, 0.4, 1.0) mol.
The ionic case has one liquid phase, feed amounts (0.98, 0.01, 0.01) mol and
an active cation packing diameter; it uses an accepted equilibrium center.
[`centers.csv`](results/centers.csv) retains all coordinates, identical between
baseline and corrected builds.
The current [`compare.cpp`](scripts/compare.cpp) calls the Engine calculation;
it retains no second row-series assembly or stencil calculation.

## Falsifier and other-entry preservation

One compact persistent native check, `boundary_checks packing-derivative`,
compares the ionic column's three chemical rows and pressure row against
centered stencils at both steps.
Its **2e-9 per-angstrom absolute tolerance** covers the step study's largest
observed discrepancy, **1.34814e-9 per angstrom**; the old missing-chain error
in the first row is **0.2334273 per angstrom**.
This is a derivative/reference rounding allowance, independent of the solve's
stopping tolerance.
The check fails on the dense baseline and all eight comparisons pass after
correction.
[`stencils.csv`](results/stencils.csv) retains these values.

| Matrix case | Entries | Bitwise differences | Material corrections |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Neutral, fixed T/P | 56 | 5 | 0 |
| Neutral, free T/P, pins, scaled feed | 126 | 20 | 0 |
| Ionic packing diameter | 48 | 9 | 4 |

[`columns.csv`](results/columns.csv) retains every baseline and corrected entry.
The four authorized material changes are the ionic parameter column in rows
0–3.
Every other entry satisfies 1e-12 relative agreement.
The remaining 30 bitwise differences comprise 12 signed zeros and 18 rounding
changes, with absolute differences at most 2.22045e-16 and relative differences
at most 4.7e-15. One small entry differs by about 24 units in the last place.

| Retained native selection | Rows | Judged rows | False judgments |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Boundary S9 | 128 | 128 | 0 |
| Equilibrium S10 | 4865 | 4865 | 0 |
| E5 pinned | 675 | 339 | 0 |
| E5 reactive | 520 | 268 | 0 |
| E5 identities | 79 | 79 | 0 |

All **6267** native rows retain their numerical values and semantic fields
within 1e-12 relative agreement.
Only seven numeric fields differ, by at most **1.96242e-16 relative**; every
criterion and judgment is unchanged.
[`native-comparisons.csv`](results/native-comparisons.csv) retains their values;
`summary.json` also identifies the comparison of the complete native records,
including input and diagnostic fields.

## Cost and caller consequence

Each measured call returns a complete matrix and includes preparation, after
30 warmup calls and in seven repetitions of 30 calls.
The initial investigation measured both alternatives in alternating order in
one executable, under the then-required shared command lock.
Its separate timing medians and quotients were:

| Case | Dense (microseconds/call) | Proposed row series (microseconds/call) | Quotient |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Neutral, fixed T/P | 53.2282 | 99.8404 | 1.88 |
| Neutral, free T/P, pins, scaled feed | 219.4911 | 336.5913 | 1.53 |
| Ionic packing diameter | 112.1113 | 213.9490 | 1.91 |

The owner accepted this additional per-call cost.
Final installed-call measurements in separate baseline/corrected builds,
under the updated CPU policy while other jobs shared the host, gave:

| Case | Dense (microseconds/call) | Corrected (microseconds/call) | Quotient |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Neutral, fixed T/P | 87.3038 | 167.7556 | 1.92 |
| Neutral, free T/P, pins, scaled feed | 175.1796 | 411.4442 | 2.35 |
| Ionic packing diameter | 100.2344 | 225.6361 | 2.25 |

[`cost.csv`](results/cost.csv) separates these two measurement studies.
Geometry is recorded for each control direction.
The separate-build timing ratios include changing shared-host load and do not
isolate implementation cost as closely as the initial alternating study.
No speedup or larger-system cost result is claimed.
The tables contain a few scalar comparisons; a plot would not clarify the
correction or its cost limit.

Lithium's `run_live_derivatives.py` calls this matrix from
`mpmath_first_actions`, selecting columns after T/P for its affine feed map.
Its default reference uses `independent_network.build_model`, which constructs
`epcsaft.Mixture(parameters)` with no active parameters.
The saponified campaign's `stage_chemistry.build_live_reference` similarly uses
`mechanism_candidates.model`, also with no active parameters.
Thus neither inspected declaration activates an ion packing-diameter parameter;
the material correction has no column exposed there.
The Engine constructor maps an omitted active list to an empty native list.
The inspection source hashes are retained in `summary.json`.
Lithium was neither edited nor run, and arbitrary externally supplied reference
models were not qualified by this source inspection.

## Verification, counts and limits

The corrected non-editable wheel passed `tools/check-all.sh`: 113 Python tests
passed, including the two requested continuation selections, and all fast
native/static checks passed.
The explicit native selections above and the new falsifier also passed.
The current Khudaida slice passed its eight declared two-liquid states and
IDAES mappings.
Against a fresh native/non-editable baseline at `bdde4003`, its
`stage-results.csv`, `engine-residuals.csv` and
`qualification-comparison.csv` are byte-identical; their sizes and hashes are
retained in `summary.json`.
This replay preserves the existing Khudaida qualification and does not broaden
its physical or global-stability claim.

The correction removes **75 net Equilibrium runtime lines**: 17 added and 92
removed, Equilibrium 6129 → 6054, total 20208 → 20133.
Other layers are unchanged.
The hard Equilibrium ceiling is 7575: measured 6054 plus the existing remaining
shared roadmap allowance of 1521 lines, with no additional allocation.
`tools/check-affected.sh HEAD` also passed, including the full equilibrium,
boundary and parameter-fit native programs.
The independent [delivered review](results/review.md) of `09bcb72f` returned
**Supported**, with no required code corrections. It confirms the correction,
falsifier, preservation comparisons and final runtime counts.
The review recommends owner acknowledgment of the higher separate-build timing
ratios; these were measured under changing host load and do not isolate the
algorithm's cost as closely as the accepted interleaved study.
Neutral sigma and dispersion-energy lever columns were verified algebraically
by review, rather than by the retained before/after matrix. The stencil
tolerance is empirical for the inspected state and build.
The notebook has not been promoted for manuscript use.
